[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = *[[Snow Golem (Frost Invasion)|Snow Golem]] *[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] (Wave 11 onwards) *[[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)|Frost Necromancer]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snow Minion''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It did not spawn naturally, instead being spawned from other enemies. The '''Snow Minion''' was a relatively quick enemy and had the same health as the [[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)|Packed Ice]]. The '''Snow Minion''' had a chance of being spawned from the [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] upon its death. Two '''Snow Minions''' were spawned from the [[Snow Golem (Frost Invasion)|Snow Golem]] when it died and four '''Snow Minions''' could be spawned from the [[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)|Frost Necromancer]] per ability. ==Appearance== The '''Snow Minion''' appears to resemble a smaller and weaker counterpart of the [[Snow Golem (Frost Invasion)|Snow Golem]]. The '''Snow Minion''' has white skin, while its legs and torso are light grey. Its entire body has a snow texture. Its head shape is unique as it was not round, with some part sticking out of the head. On its arms and legs were ice blocks, and on its shoulders are snow crystals. The '''Snow Minion''' has a running animation and its left arm appeared across its torso. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *Multiple [[Minigunner]]s should be sufficient in dealing with '''Snow Minions'''. *It is recommended to use the [[DJ Booth]] to the extend range of towers in case '''Snow Minions''' manage to escape the defenses. **You can use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost nearby towers' firerate to defeat hordes of '''Snow Minions'''. *You can use towers that hit multiple enemies, like the [[Gladiator]] and [[Mortar]], to deal with groups of '''Snow Minions'''. **The [[Pursuit]] can easily wipe numerous hordes of '''Snow Minions''' out. *The [[Toxic Gunner]] can help in slowing these enemies down as they are quite quick. **As they spawn in hordes, it is recommended to have multiple [[Toxic Gunner]]s with different target settings to slow down as many of these as possible. *As with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Snow Minion''' (though normal damage is not doubled). ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacySnowMinion.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} FrostUpdateIcon.png|'''Snow Minion''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Snow Minion''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionSnowMinionIconIG.png|'''Snow Minion''' on its icon. }} ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' -
